t: This is the statue of George Canning in Parliament Square, made in 1832 by Sir Richard Westmacott. Canning was a Tory statesman who served two terms as Foreign Secretary. He became Prime Minister on the twelfth of April 1827, but his time in office was cut short when he died just 119 days later, on the eighth of August. So he is remembered here for one of the shortest premierships in British history, set among the figures of the place where he worked.
